ipc_sections.title: Punishment of criminal conspiracy
ipc_sections.description: Whoever is a party to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment for a term of two years or upwards, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had abetted such offence.
ipc_sections.punishment: Same as the offence conspired, or imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both if no punishment is specified

ipc_sections.title: Waging war against the Government of India
ipc_sections.description: Whoever wages war against the Government of India, or attempts to wage such war, or abets the waging of such war, shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Death or life imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for murder
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Death or life imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Causing death by negligence
ipc_sections.description: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 2 years imprisonment or fine or both

ipc_sections.title: Dowry death
ipc_sections.description: Where the death of a woman is caused by any burns or bodily injury or occurs otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of her marriage and it is shown that soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by her husband or any relative of her husband for, or in connection with, any demand for dowry, such death shall be called 'dowry death', and such husband or relative shall be deemed to have caused her death.
ipc_sections.punishment: Minimum 7 years imprisonment, may extend to life imprisonment

ipc_sections.title: Abetment of suicide of child or insane person
ipc_sections.description: If any person under eighteen years of age, any insane person, any delirious person, any idiot, or any person in a state of intoxication, commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term not exceeding ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Death or life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Abetment of suicide
ipc_sections.description: If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Attempt to murder
ipc_sections.description: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 10 years imprisonment and fine; if hurt caused, life imprisonment possible

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 1 year imprisonment or fine up to Rs. 1000 or both

ipc_sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting, or any instrument which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine or both

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 335, voluntarily causes grievous hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 335, voluntarily causes grievous hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting, or any instrument which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
ipc_sections.description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Minimum 1 year, up to 5 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for kidnapping
ipc_sections.description: Whoever kidnaps any person from India or from lawful guardianship, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine person
ipc_sections.description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any person with intent to cause that person to be secretly and wrongfully confined, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for rape
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Minimum 10 years rigorous imprisonment, up to life imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Unnatural offences
ipc_sections.description: Whoever voluntarily has carnal intercourse against the order of nature with any man, woman or animal, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for theft
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine or both

ipc_sections.title: Theft in dwelling house, etc.
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits theft in any building, tent or vessel, which building, tent or vessel is used as a human dwelling, or used for the custody of property, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for robbery
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for dacoity
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Dacoity with murder
ipc_sections.description: If any one of five or more persons, who are conjointly committing dacoity, commits murder in so committing dacoity, every one of those persons shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Death or life imprisonment or up to 10 years rigorous imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
ipc_sections.description: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine or both

ipc_sections.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
ipc_sections.description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc.
ipc_sections.description: Whoever forges a document which purports to be a valuable security or a will, or an authority to adopt a son, or which purports to give authority to any person to make or transfer any valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Using as genuine a forged document
ipc_sections.description: Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document which he knows or has reason to believe to be a forged document, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had forged such document.
ipc_sections.punishment: Same as forgery of that document

ipc_sections.title: Counterfeiting currency notes or bank notes
ipc_sections.description: Whoever counterfeits, or knowingly performs any part of the process of counterfeiting, any currency note or bank note, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment and fine

ipc_sections.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
ipc_sections.description: Whoever, intending to insult the modesty of any woman, utters any word, makes any sound or gesture, or exhibits any object, intending that such word or sound shall be heard, or that such gesture or object shall be seen, by such woman, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, and also with fine.
ipc_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years simple imprisonment and fine

bns_sections.title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent to secretly and wrongfully confine person
bns_sections.description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any person with intent to cause that person to be secretly and wrongfully confined, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
bns_sections.punishment: Up to 7 years imprisonment and fine

bns_sections.title: Punishment for rape
bns_sections.description: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
bns_sections.punishment: Minimum 10 years rigorous imprisonment, up to life imprisonment and fine

bns_sections.title: Sexual intercourse by husband upon his wife during separation
bns_sections.description: Whoever has sexual intercourse with his own wife, who is living separately, whether under a decree of separation or otherwise, without her consent, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine.
bns_sections.punishment: Up to 2 years imprisonment and fine

bns_sections.title: Punishment for theft
bns_sections.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
bns_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years imprisonment or fine or both

bns_sections.punishment: Same as forgery of that document

bns_sections.title: Husband or relative of husband subjecting woman to cruelty

bns_sections.punishment: Up to 3 years simple imprisonment and fine

bns_sections.title: Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim
bns_sections.description: Whoever commits an offence punishable under section 64 or section 65 and in the course of such commission inflicts an injury which causes the death of the victim or causes the victim to be in a persistent vegetative state, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than twenty years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life, or with death.
bns_sections.punishment: Minimum 20 years rigorous imprisonment, up to life imprisonment or death
